description_en: Queries the review status of a card message template and returns review information from mobile phone manufacturers
description_zh: 查询卡片短信模板审核状态，返回手机厂商审核相关信息
name: QueryCardSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The code of the card message template. Valid values:

The value of the TemplateCode response parameter returned after you call the [CreateCardSmsTemplate](~~CreateCardSmsTemplate~~) operation is the code of the newly created card message template.

You can also log on to the console and go to the China Card Messages (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page to view the card message template code on the Template Management tab
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。取值：

调用[创建卡片短信模板](~~CreateCardSmsTemplate~~)接口后，返回参数TemplateCode即为新创建的卡片短信模板Code。

您也可登录控制台国内卡片短信 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面，在模板管理页签查看卡片短信模板Code
parameters.name: template_code
